title: Cauliflower yassa with olives
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into large thick pieces. Slice the onions thinly.
In a large bowl, mix the mustard, lemon juice, salt, pepper, finely chopped garlic and the ginger. Add the onions and cauliflower and toss. Marinate for 1 hour, or overnight if you can.
Lift the cauliflower out of the marinade and set aside. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a non-stick pan and cook the onions until translucent.
Add the coconut sugar, bay leaves, parsley and olives and stir. Add 3 tbsp water, cover and cook until the onions are meltingly soft.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a frying pan and fry the cauliflower pieces until lightly golden, keeping them fairly firm.
Add the cauliflower to the onions, stir, adjust the seasoning and serve hot with rice.
